title: PM-Eng 1:1 prep - API / Console / Dedicated / Private
content:
Context: weekly 1:1 with Eng Lead (Ethan). Focus: short-term blocking work for API/Console rollout, Dedicated capacity sizing asks, and Private deployment checklist for pilot customer. Goal: leave with clear owners and next steps; flag any infra or SRE blockers that need escalation.

Priority recap (for quick reference):
- Production API stability: latency spikes on long-context chat (p95 increased from 180ms -> 350ms last week).
- Console rollout: feature gating + role-based access for orgs; need UX + backend alignment for RBAC v1.
- Dedicated: two mid-market customers signed up for limited beta - need commit on GPU types and autoscale policy.
- Private pilot: compliance checklist (KMS/HSM integration + audit logging) outstanding items.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick sync (3m) - recent wins / morale
2) API incidents & mitigations (8m) - root cause hypotheses, immediate mitigations, longer-term perf work
3) Console RBAC + rollout plan (6m) - status, gaps, timeline for canary
4) Dedicated beta sizing & SLA asks (7m) - confirm resource plan and account exec involvement
5) Private pilot blockers & handoff (4m) - infra tickets, security review, timeline
6) Action items & decisions (2m)

Notes / talking points:
- API latency spike:
  - Observed during two long-chat customer jobs (seq len > 8k tokens). Memory and KV cache pressure suspected.
  - Temporary mitigation already: reduce max_window for these customers and enable stricter prefix caching - reduced p95 by ~30% in limited tests.
  - Ask for Eng: can we prioritize a short perf patch to KV cache eviction (low-risk) + schedule a deeper allocation review? Estimate: patch 2d, deeper work 2 sprints.
  - Linked artifact: ENG-2345 (profiling traces + flamegraphs).

- Console RBAC:
  - PMs pushed a first pass wireframe for org-level roles (owner/admin/developer/viewer). UX wants a backend toggle to enable org RBAC per account before canary.
  - Backend status: PR merged for roles table (PR#456) but needs integration tests and a migration rollback plan.
  - Risk: migration could affect small orgs during rollout window. Suggest canary on Dedicated-only customers first.
  - Ask: Sasha (backend) needs a week to finish tests; can we delay broad canary by 1 week and notify product-marketing?

- Dedicated beta:
  - Two customers (fintech & analytics) asked for predictable latency under 200ms p95 for short-context generation. They requested reserved A100-equivalent pools.
  - Ops concerns: limited A100 capacity in region-us-west2; alternatives: multi-GPU V100 with tighter batching or commit to multi-region.
  - Proposed plan: offer a committed vCPU/GPU mix (#G:2xA100 equiv per-customer) for beta with explicit burst policy and fallback to hosted-model with throttled SLO.
  - Ask: decision on GPU family by Fri (Mar 5) so sales can confirm contracts. Who owns escalation to infra for capacity reservation? -> Ethan to confirm.

- Private pilot (enterprise customer):
  - Compliance checklist outstanding: KMS integration (customer wants HSM-backed KEK), audit log retention window, and network peering specifics.
  - Security review scheduled Mar 12. Need SRE and infra input on KMS/HSM options (do we ship with AWS CloudHSM or support customer HSM?).
  - Short-term workaround: provide customer with private deployment with KMS stub + elevated logging (not HSM) until we validate HSM flow. Documented risk & sign-off required.

Decision points we need in 1:1:
- Approve performance patch (KV eviction) to go into next hotfix (Y/N).
- Delay Console broad canary by 1 week to finish backend tests (Y/N).
- Confirm Dedicated GPU family for beta commit (A100 vs V100 alternatives) and owner to escalate capacity (who calls infra?).
- Approve Private pilot HSM workaround and timeline to complete full HSM integration.

Current blocking items / asks for Ethan:
- Allocate 2d of backend eng for KV eviction patch (assign: Priya?).
- Escalate to infra on Dedicated capacity availability and confirm reservation process (owner: Ethan).
- Help prioritize integration tests for RBAC migration (owner: Sasha, ask Ethan to unblock if needed).
- Pull in SRE for KMS/HSM compatibility doc before Mar 12 security review (owner: Lena).

Action items (assigned):
- Morgan: write customer-facing beta doc for Dedicated (template + SLOs) - due Mar 4.
- Ethan: escalate Dedicated GPU availability and commit owner - due Mar 5.
- Priya: implement KV eviction patch, open PR, link to ENG-2345 - due Mar 3.
- Sasha: finish RBAC integration tests and create migration rollback plan - due Mar 6.
- Lena: draft KMS/HSM compatibility note and runbook for security review - due Mar 10.
- Aisha: notify product-marketing about potential canary delay and update comms - due Mar 2.

Follow-up items for next 1:1 (Mar 9):
- Perf patch status and measurement (was p95 returned to baseline?).
- Dedicated capacity confirmation and customer sign-off.
- Console canary start date and rollback criteria.
- Private pilot sign-off after security review.

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- Keep measurements short and reproducible: include a trimmed trace for LONG_CHAT case in ENG-2345.
- Consider temporary rate-limit for long-context jobs if KV patch delayed beyond sprint.
- If infra can't reserve A100, prepare pricing concession for customers (discounted rate until we provide A100).

Misc references:
- ENG-2345 profiling traces (linked), PR#456 backend roles migration, Private-pilot security checklist (Confluence page linked above).

End of doc.
